summary: Implementation plan to migrate AUTOGO from Chennai (Kelambakkam/OMR) to Thiruvannamalai District, specifically configuring Thandarampet, Thanipadi, and surrounding hubs (Chengam, Sathanur Dam, Vanapuram, Radhapuram, Veraiyur, Thiruvannamalai Town) with TN 25 registration numbers, regional distance matrix, and custom SVG map routes.
